questions.question: Which cost result is the paper headline? README and the archived report give -23.84% +/- 0.15 (N=5, 11-query corpus, equal accuracy 0.545; artifact transactive_seeds_20260621_b4b1094.json is absent from the package), while REPRODUCIBILITY.md and the only present artifact give -22.09% (n=50, N=10, CI 17.93-26.27). May the 23.84% / +39.14 figures appear in the paper (they cannot be checked), or only the n=50/N=10 result?
options: Cite both, with the missing artifact supplied
questions.consequence: Until answered, the 11-query numbers stay BLOCKED and out of the paper

questions.question: Can the paper say routing cuts cost 'at equal answer accuracy', and that accuracy 'saturates under parametric knowledge'? The present n=50 artifact (seeds 66-110) shows A1 accuracy 0.68-0.70 vs A0 0.72 (answerability equal at 0.98), the 'equal accuracy 0.545' figure comes from an absent 11-query artifact, and the four-system run shows accuracy far from saturated (No-Memory EM 0.3333 vs RAG 0.7083). What accuracy statement do the authors stand behind?
options: Report accuracy as measured (A1 slightly below A0, no test)
Keep 'equal accuracy' wording with an author-supplied source
questions.consequence: Equal-accuracy and saturation claims stay BLOCKED and out of the paper

questions.question: README rows for E2 stationary/drift/refutation/new-topic (MiniLM), E7 cross-model, E5 FLAT null and the multi-agent run (route@1 0.917) cite artifacts that are not in the package. May these values be cited as author-reported results (soft, unverifiable), or must the artifacts be supplied first?
options: Cite as author-reported soft values with a stated caveat
questions.consequence: Those claims stay BLOCKED and out of the paper

questions.question: README says ASMOS adapts at 'zero retraining and zero added labels', but both E2 new-topic artifacts record labels_consumed = 10 for ASMOS (equal to the retraining classifiers). How do the authors define 'added labels'? Is the claim 'zero retraining' only?
options: Provide the definition of labels that makes zero true
questions.consequence: The zero-labels wording stays BLOCKED and out of the paper

questions.question: The blind review (v001_1) found the method cannot be reconstructed from the package. Please supply, or point to files that record: (1) what a 'claim' and a verification outcome are and how outcomes are produced; (2) how a query's topic is assigned; (3) the ownership update rule and the prior value; (4) whether ownership is learned before or during the 50 evaluation queries (train/evaluate separation); (5) what a 'candidate' is (global search considers 32.0 per query with two agents); (6) what the seeds randomise at temperature 0; (7) the denominator of route@1 (0.909, 0.614) and the criterion for 'routed the new topic' in a seed; (8) the operational definition of answerability and how accuracy is graded, and what the query classes Q1-Q5 are; (9) the embedder used in the 10-seed cost run; (10) the classifier baselines' input features and tuning, and the number of agents in the new-topic runs; (11) why A2 (never routes) differs slightly from A0 in tokens, candidate-set size and hit rate; (12) the exact-match and token-F1 definitions in the four-system run (exact match exceeds token-F1 for ASMOS+RAG).
options: Confirm these stay marked as undocumented
questions.consequence: Until answered, the paper marks each item [ASK AUTHOR] and states it as undocumented; no mechanism detail is invented.
